$comment: Applied output of the video-producer agent. One Reel per client per month per CLAUDE.md §9. Aditi's Spice Depot May 2026 Reel: hand-grinding cardamom (or sambar masala) — high motion-potential subject because spice dust catches the light. Image-to-video via FAL.AI Kling 3.0 standard tier 5s, ~$0.50. Pegged to the May 22 slot reserved in social-calendar.json.

photo_selection.$comment: video-producer scores monthly_intakes.photo_urls. For this Reel: prefer a tight closeup of whole green cardamom pods (still motion potential = the dust as they tumble into a grinder) OR hands at the grinder with the spice powder visible. Subject portrait or near-square aspect (Kling outputs 16:9 by default; we re-frame at upload).
photo_selection.selected_photo_url: TODO: operator picks closeup of cardamom pods OR hands at the grinder from May intake (WhatsApp drop)
selection_criteria: Subject clearly identifiable (whole cardamom pods OR hands at grinder)
Lighting natural — warm shop interior, no blown-out highlights
Motion potential — dust / pods tumbling / grinder dial visible
Aspect — portrait or near-square preferred for Reels framing
Match this month's pillar — signature_item: Idukki green cardamom
photo_selection.selection_notes: If 0 acceptable photos in intake, skip the Reel for May and refund the slot to June. Do NOT submit a placeholder image — burns the FAL.AI $0.50 with no usable output. Fallback subject if cardamom photos don't land: sambar masala grinding (also high-motion, Tuesday ritual is documentable).

fal_job_spec.prompt: Whole green cardamom pods tumbling slowly into the grinder. Subtle ambient motion — light dust catches the air above the pods. Camera holds still. Natural shop daylight. No zoom.
fal_job_spec.negative_prompt: extra fingers, distorted hands, melting, AI artifacts, fast zoom, color shift, neon, sparkles, glitter, glow, blur, fish-eye, rotating, extra plates, extra dishes, morphing, magical effects, fake bokeh, warping, oversaturation, motion blur on subject

captions_and_overlay.ig_caption: Idukki cardamom. Whole pods, into the grinder. Powder you can smell from the door. $14.99 / 100g · Ashburn + Herndon · 10–9 every day.
captions_and_overlay.music_mood: warm-acoustic-no-bass-drop — operator picks from IG's licensed library at upload time. Avoid Bollywood film tracks (rights complicated for business accounts) and avoid generic 'world music' tropes.

cost_tracking.operator_approval_required_for: 10s tier (~$1.00) — skip unless festival peak week (e.g., Diwali week in October)

failure_path: If Kling output has visible artifacts on 2 consecutive submissions: pick a different source photo (try the sambar masala fallback subject), re-submit once more, then skip for the month if still bad. Do not paper over with creative editing.
If cardamom subject reads ambiguously (Kling re-interprets pods as 'beans' or 'capsules'): tighten the prompt to 'green cardamom pods, oval shape, ridged surface' and re-submit.
